diff_summary: Wired exact core simulation tick and removed duplicate main body, preserving legacy model and sector-helper exports;22 regression cases pass.

verification.command: env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/python -c 'import ast,importlib; source=ast.parse(open("backend/app/main.py").read()); assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="advance_simulation_tick" for n in source.body); m=importlib.import_module("backend.app.main"); c=importlib.import_module("backend.app.core.simulation_tick"); assert m.advance_simulation_tick is c.advance_simulation_tick; assert hasattr(m,"Decision") and hasattr(m,"IncidentIn"); print("PASS direct tick alias, oldbody removed, model exports retained")' && env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_simulation_replay.py && env APP_ENV=local PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_api.py -k 'incident_decisions_always_return_current_driver_state or unsupported_sanction_fields_are_rejected_with_guidance or unsupported_sanction_zero_and_points_only_decisions_remain_valid' && .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app/main.py backend/app/core/simulation_tick.py && .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app/main.py backend/app/core/simulation_tick.py
